scripts.vendor: mkdir -p public/vendor/pyodide public/vendor/java && ([ -f public/vendor/clang/llvm.core.wasm.gz ] || (mkdir -p public/vendor/clang && cp -r node_modules/@yowasp/clang/gen/. public/vendor/clang/ && gzip -9f public/vendor/clang/llvm.core.wasm public/vendor/clang/llvm-resources.tar)) && for f in pyodide.mjs pyodide.asm.mjs pyodide.asm.wasm python_stdlib.zip pyodide-lock.json; do cp node_modules/pyodide/$f public/vendor/pyodide/; done && ([ -f public/vendor/java/tools.jar ] || cp spike/tools.jar public/vendor/java/ 2>/dev/null || curl -fsSL -o public/vendor/java/tools.jar https://raw.githubusercontent.com/leaningtech/javafiddle/main/static/tools.jar)
